gates.requirement: Each operator independently verifies the other peer's public key out of band; do not use a self-reported field as proof.
Pin native Xi endpoint, packet schema bytes, explicit mapping to xi.exchange.v1, and supported status semantics.
Two separate human decisions approve exact peer, route, time, scope and revocation path.
Mutually authenticated encrypted transport with endpoint verification and key rotation/revocation policy.
Only agreed read-only synthetic operation; remote shell, filesystem browsing, model/repo writes all denied.
Written scope limits data class, maximum bytes, retention and allowed destination; no ambient data sharing.
Source author, exact bytes, digest, intended use and evidence class survive through both ends.
Each independent house demonstrates local pause, revoke and disconnect with no damage to the other.
Two physically distinct hosts exchange a single synthetic digest via approved transport and publish redacted evidence.
Each peer independently validates receipt binders and restart-persistent replay refusals.
Reject wrong key, room, scope, route, expired timestamp, tamper, replay, and revoked operator.
Separate explicit review authorizes one small nonsecret example capsule. Never infer permission from discovery.
Exact byte identity and source provenance independently attested at both sides.
A live field pilot demonstrates unilateral revocation before/after reconnect, including restart.
PhiOS and ForgeCore each remain available with the bridge offline, without shared root authority.
Separate recovery drill documents human-approved fallback, data integrity and no unintended replication.
